_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.126(2)(d): "on account of medical expenditure incurred on the health of any parent of the assessee, up to ₹50000 in aggregate" (Gazette 265620, p.161). Entered only as a HealthPayment, never a plain qualifying payment: the limits turn on whom it covers — family ("the spouse and dependant children", s.126(10)(b)) or parents, senior citizen or not (s.126(7), (8)(a)). The insurer's scheme must be approved (s.126(11)) — an entry condition. D-136. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80D(2)(d): medical expenditure on a parent, a senior citizen who is uninsured (thc p.341). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B11; D-145.
